evidence_items.title: yasalma/TUNSEV-turkic-benchmark
evidence_items.summary: TUNSEV — Turkic Unified Next-sentence Evaluation benchmark "Context | next sentence" tasks in Turkic languages. Scoring by log-probabilities, without generation. Purpose The benchmark measures how well a model captures the connection between adjacent sentences, distinguishing the true continuation of a text from a sentence taken from elsewhere. It measures the model's understanding of the meaning of what is happening – who acts, what happened, what follows from… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yasalma/TUNSEV-turkic-benchmark.

evidence_items.summary: SWE-bench Pro 120-sample subset A 120-task subset of ScaleAI/SWE-bench_Pro, created to make local evaluation faster.
